artworks.title: Saint Hugo of Lincoln (or Saint Hugo of Avalon)
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: This print shows a person standing upright, facing the left. The person is wearing long robes and has a tall, pointed hat on their head, and they are holding a tall staff. Their facial features are slightly faded and hard to distinguish, but they have a halo around their head. On the ground near their feet, by the bottom-left corner, there appears to be a swan-like bird with a curved neck. On the right, there is a shield with an emblem floating in the air. The background shows small flowers on the ground and wavy lines in the sky suggesting clouds. At the bottom of the print, there is a faded inscription.

artworks.title: Saint Bruno
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a person standing upright. The individual is positioned facing forward and is adorned with a halo of rays around the head. The person has simple facial features, distinguished mainly by prominent eyes and a small mouth. They have no visible hair as the halo encircles their head closely. The attire consists of a long, flowing robe with distinct folds down the front, covering the person’s entire figure. In their right hand, they hold an object resembling a palm or branch, and a scroll extends from their left hand, with writing on it. Next to the figure, there is a coat of arms on the right and a closed book with a latch on the left. The background is plain but enclosed within a decorative border that outlines the figure.

artworks.title: Saint Hugo of Grenoble
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing with a headdress. The style includes intricate patterns. decorative elements like stars, floral motifs, and wavy lines surround the figure. The background includes a border with ornate detailing, possibly text.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist [recto]
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing with his left leg slightly forward. The man has a beard and curly hair, and wears a robe adorned with a halo around his head. He holds a staff in his right hand. The background shows horizontal lines, and the ground has stylized plants. Inscribed at the bottom is "Johannes baptista."

artworks.title: Saint Agnes [verso]
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a robed figure holding a lamb and a palm branch. The image features a robed figure standing on a landscape with hills in the background. The figure holds a lamb close to its chest while clutching a palm branch in the other hand. The lines are black, etched or printed onto a plain background, emphasizing the contours and details of the robe, halo, and palm. The border framing the image and script at the bottom suggest an ecclesiastical or religious manuscript style.

artworks.title: Saint Alto, Saint Bridget and the Founders  of the Mariamunster
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, brown, gray, and yellow
artworks.description: The image is an intricate and colorful illustration on aged paper. It features various figures, including a central woman seated in a dark robe with a hood, holding an open book. Surrounding her are smaller figures: one resembling a child with a halo and another in red ecclesiastical garments and a bishop's mitre, holding a shield. Two smaller figures above may be angels, set within a leafy background with architectural elements. The illustration is bordered with green vines and a central cross motif at the top. The image is rich with symbolic and religious iconography reminiscent of medieval or early Renaissance illuminated manuscripts.

artworks.title: Saint Alto
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand colored in burgundy, blue-green, orange, brown, red, and yellow-green
artworks.description: This print shows a person standing, appearing to cut down a tree next to them with a small blue blade. The person has a round face with pale skin, rosy cheeks, simple facial features, and short, curly, brown hair. They are wearing a blue hat with a cross, a brown robe over a blue-and-white garment, cream-colored gloves, and red boots. In the background, there are trees on the right, some of which are already down, and on the left is a red church and a flat gray object. White birds fly in the gray sky, holding branches in their beaks. The ground is a pinkish-tan color.

artworks.title: Saint Anne, The Madonna and Child, and a Franciscan Monk
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored red lake, green, rose, yellow, and gray
artworks.description: The image shows four figures. Three are seated on a bench, and one is kneeling. The central figure is a woman with a child on her right knee. She has soft eyes, a halo, a headdress covering her hair, and a red robe with green drapery underneath. Beside her is a young girl with a halo, long blond hair, and a dress. To the right, a smaller figure is kneeling with clasped hands. All figures have halos. The background features ornate gold designs framing the upper section of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Anne with the Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow, green, red
artworks.description: The image shows three figures from the knees up. In the center, a seated woman holds a small child on her lap. The woman has long flowing hair covered by a veil and simple facial features. She wears a yellow garment with a red undercloak. The child has curly hair and a halo, and is partially nude. Beside them, another woman kneels, wearing a green robe and a crown. The background includes architectural elements with floral decorations and a sun and moon motif. The ground is adorned with colorful flowers.

artworks.title: Saint Apollonia
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, and brown
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. The central figure is sitting, while two others stand around them. The seated person has light blond hair styled close to their head, wearing a red robe with a green halo. One standing figure, to the left, holds an object resembling a chisel. This figure has curly blond hair and wears a green garment with red hose. The other standing figure, to the right, wears a large, pink hat and grey tunic. The background features grassy areas and buildings resembling churches or castles, with a radiant sun above them.

artworks.title: Saint Augustine
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in black, brown, ochre, green, tan, brick red, and mauve
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene where a bishop presents a pierced heart to a divine figure in the sky. The bishop is adorned in traditional ecclesiastical clothing and stands within a decorated room with a wooden canopy and books. He holds an arrow-pierced heart aloft, and speech scrolls are depicted coming from both figures' mouths. The divine figure floats on a cloud, surrounded by a halo, and holds a crucifix. Below, a congregation of people in medieval attire, including monks and townspeople, looks up in reverence. The setting includes a medieval church with a bell tower. The style is reminiscent of late Gothic religious illustrations.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, green, and rose
artworks.dimensions:

sheet: 20.9 x 15 cm (8 1/4 x 5 7/8 in.)

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Barbara
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, green, blue, yellow, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval scene near a castle. The image shows a figure in elaborate attire raising a sword towards another figure in a red gown who appears to be in a state of submission, kneeling or praying. In the background is a structure resembling a castle or fortified tower. The ground is depicted with green colors representing grass. The overall style is reminiscent of early European religious or historical illustrations, possibly influenced by German woodcuts from the late Middle Ages.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Barbara
artworks.medium: woodcut in lt. brown, hand-colored in red lake, green, blue, yellow, rose, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene with two figures. One figure is holding a sword above the other figure who is kneeling with clasped hands. The setting appears to be in a medieval style, possibly depicting a mythological or historical context. The upper figure wears a red hat and blue robe, while the kneeling figure wears a red gown with a halo-like circle above their head. In the background, there is a tower-like structure, rolling green fields, and a blue sky. The painting is framed with an orange border.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving
artworks.description: The image displays two figures, a woman and a child. The woman is sitting holding the child in her arms. Both figures have halos around their heads. The woman wears flowing robes and her hair is loose. The child is nude. The background is textured with a reddish-brown tone.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, green, blue, ochre, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a throne or bench. The person has a serene face with long, flowing hair and is wearing a robe with red and blue colors. A large halo is above their head. They are holding a depiction of a tall building in their left hand. The setting includes a green base they are seated on, a blue background, and a beige border framing the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, blue, yellow, green,gold
artworks.description: The image features a person seated with their right side facing the viewer. They have long wavy hair, a serene expression, and wear a round, dark object on their head. The person wears a blue garment with a red-brown robe draped over it. They hold a model of a building in their left hand and there is a cup beside them. The background has horizontal blue lines and the ground is green. The image is framed in a box with a light border.

artworks.title: Saint Bernard of Clairvaux
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in black, yellow, green, orange, gold, and red
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One figure is depicted from the waist up, leaning out from a large wooden cross. This figure has unkempt, long hair and wears a crown of thorns. They have a somber expression with closed eyes. The other figure, kneeling, is clothed in a long, black robe with a hood. This person has short, light brown hair with a white band around it and is looking up at the figure on the cross. Their face expresses focus with wide, outlined eyes and an open mouth. The kneeling figure holds the other person around the waist with both hands. In the background, there is a simple depiction of green floor with a beige backdrop, bordered with a red frame. A pair of black slippers are at the base of the cross, on the green ground.

artworks.title: Saint Bernard with the Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, green, black, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows two adults and a child, all visible from the waist up, set against a green and red patterned background. The adult on the left has a halo, hand-drawn facial features, and light hair under a dark headband. They wear a black robe with a white inner garment and appear to be holding an object. The adult on the right also has a halo and delicate facial features with long, flowing blonde hair. They wear a gold crown and a red robe. The child, seated in front, is nude and holds a playful posture with rounded cheeks and light hair. They sit on a red cloth. All figures have halos above their heads. The scene is framed with a red and green border.

artworks.title: Saint Bridget
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, red, brown, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene. In the center, a figure sits in ecclesiastical robes with a halo, holding a writing instrument and appearing to write in a book. They are surrounded by an angel. Above them, a divine vision occurs, including a dove and figures with halos. Additional elements such as shields and a monk-like figure in prayer are present. The scene suggests a profound moment of divine inspiration or revelation. The style is reminiscent of medieval religious art, possibly influenced by early European woodcuts.

artworks.title: Saint Bridget
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange-pink, green, yellow, green-blue, and white
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a full-body frontal pose. The person has a serene expression, mainly covered hair by a headdress resembling a veil or hood. They wear a colorful robe and hold a book in one hand and a cross in the other. A halo surrounds their head with the words "Sancta Brigitta." Decorative elements, including leaves and emblems, are present beside and below the person. The background has blue horizontal stripes on a light tan surface, enclosed within a border.

artworks.title: Saint Bridget
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange, yellow, gray, green, and orange-brown
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated at a desk, facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards a book on the desk. They have a serene facial expression, with a halo behind their head. The person has a stylized hairstyle partially covered by a veil, wearing robed clothing with a cloak and tunic. Their hand is over the open book, surrounded by religious symbols, including a cross on the desk. Next to them, a hat and a circular item hang from a stick. In the background, two figures with halos float on a cloud, observing the seated person. The illustration has an intricate woodcut style with colored highlights in red, green, and yellow tones.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in rose, yellow, green, red, blue, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing, draped in flowing garments. The figure is positioned upright, holding a long object resembling a staff in one hand, while the other hand rests on a large wheel by their side. The figure's facial features are faintly painted with a composed expression, and they have long flowing hair accentuated by a dark circle above their head. They are dressed in a reddish-brown robe with gold trim at the sleeves and hemline. The figure stands on a patch of green with a severed head depicted at their feet on the right side. The background is a light, neutral color with scattered horizontal blue strokes.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, and yellow
artworks.description: The image features a person kneeling on a green surface. The person faces slightly to the right with eyes closed and a serene expression. They have long hair, wearing a red robe over a white garment. They have a halo above their head and hold a sword vertically with both hands. Beside them is a spoked wheel. The background is a muted tone enclosed within a black border.
